mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an aggressive monetary easing that stimulates economic growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that drives wage growth and inflation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the unemployment rate is below 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts and a simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate signal a robust demand environment that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when housing starts are strong and the unemployment rate is declining (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production signals a supply chain disruption that drives inflation and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when industrial production declines sharply (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and a decline in the money supply signal a monetary tightening that reduces economic growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the federal funds rate is increasing and the money supply is declining (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in payroll employment signals a robust labor market that drives economic growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during periods of monetary easing.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong payroll employment and monetary easing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in GDP growth rate and a decline in the unemployment rate signal a robust demand environment that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during periods of early-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth and declining unemployment rate (t-test p > 0.05).
